newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth reiterated a buy rating on Archer Daniels Midland Co and raised its target price on the stock to $27.

-- On October 15 ADM reported earnings for the fiscal first quarter of $0.33 a share, excluding a charge of $0.32 for fines and litigation settlements related to a U.S. Justice Department investigation. A year earlier it earned $0.29.
-- Dain said operating earnings were above its estimate of $0.25 a share and the consenus estimate of $0.26.
-- "The primary reason for ADM's strong earnings was the favorable effect of declining commodity prices on LIFO (last in, first out) inventory valuations," Dain said in a report.
-- It said it maintains its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $1.50 a share, compared with $1.27 a year ago.
-- "ADM's corn refining business is its most important and we expect the company to benefit from lower corn prices as the year progresses," Dain wrote in a report.

-- It said ADM does not expect its grain merchandising business to perform as well in fiscal 1997 as it did in its record year in fiscal 1996. "However, the quality of crop harvests looks pretty good so far...and the company expects to see export demand increase," Dain wrote.
